parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use a correct method for the areas of the sector and semicircle and form an equation in $x$, e.g. $\frac12\cdot\frac12\pi r^2=\frac12(2r\cos x)^2x$ [M1]. Obtain $x=\cos^{-1}\sqrt{\pi/(16x)}$ correctly [A1, answer given], via correct simplification such as $\cos^2x=\pi/(16x)$. Total 2.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.answer: For $g(x)=\cos^{-1}\sqrt{\pi/(16x)}$, $g(1)=1.1117\ldots>1$ and $g(1.5)=1.2006\ldots<1.5$, so the fixed point lies between 1 and 1.5.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Calculate values of a relevant expression or pair of expressions at $x=1$ and $x=1.5$ [M1; must work in radians; at least one value must be correct]. Printed acceptable forms include $1\mapsto1.11$ and $1.5\mapsto1.20$, the signed values for $x-\cos^{-1}\sqrt{\pi/(16x)}$, the signed values for $\cos^2x-\pi/(16x)$, or those for $16x\cos^2x-\pi$. Complete the argument correctly with correct values [A1]. Total 2.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use $x_{n+1}=\cos^{-1}\sqrt{\pi/(16x_n)}$ correctly at least twice and work in radians [M1]. Obtain $1.144$ [A1]. Show sufficient iterations to at least 5 d.p. to justify $1.144$ to 3 d.p., or show a sign change in $(1.1435,1.1445)$ [A1]. Printed acceptable sequence from 1: $1,1.11173,1.13707,1.14225,1.14329,1.14349,1.14354,1.14354$; sequences from 1.25 or 1.5 are also printed. Total 3.
